summary: Restored two explicit knowledge uses for the verify question that the previous update had dropped when it replaced that question's knowledge list with the new witness entry: the election path's voter-only solicitation (which is what makes the verify path an outlier) and the follower campaign trigger with the lease-check granularity (which bounds the ordinary case). The account, its evidence, executions and its resolved gap answer are unchanged, and the new witness entry stays listed alongside them, so all three are recorded by exact revision and relied-on assertion. No execution requested. I also attempted to add a boundary experiment for the shutdown finding — whether a full verifyCh protects later callers from the strand, since a send that cannot be accepted leaves only the shutdown case selectable — but the draft harness currently holds the stall probe, so rebuilding the shutdown harness plus testing it did not fit the turn; that is the next piece of work, along with nothing else outstanding on the four questions, all of which now carry accounts with receipts.
